title: GetCharismaAV - Game
content:
Member of: Game Script

Obtains the Charisma Actor Value.

Syntax:
ActorValue Function GetCharismaAV() native global

Parameters:
None

Return Value:
The Charisma Actor Value.

Examples:
Game.GetPlayer().SetValue( Game.GetCharismaAV(), 5 )
